subject: genetics
question: **Type:** concept A trait is described as having 70 percent penetrance among individuals who carry the disease-causing allele. Which statement best describes what this means?

options.text: 70% of individuals with the allele show the trait, and 30% carry it with no sign of the trait.
70% of the population carries the allele, and the rest does not.
Individuals with the allele show the trait to a 70% degree of severity.
70% of affected individuals have a family history of the trait.

explanation: **Penetrance** is the proportion of individuals carrying a genotype who express the associated phenotype at all, so 70% (70 of every 100 carriers) would show the trait and 30% would not. C describes expressivity, which is variation in severity among people who do express the trait, and B confuses penetrance with allele frequency in the whole population. D describes a family history statistic, not a property of the genotype.
